purpose: Present the Chilean Antarctic gateway chain from southern Chile to King George Island, separating stable gateway geography and infrastructure from operator-published commercial products and from state/science capabilities.
rules: Do not equate gateway-policy status with a guaranteed commercial service.
Operator pages verify that a product is published by that operator; they do not independently verify a departure on a specific date.
Do not infer a direct Puerto Williams-Antarctica commercial flight from an itinerary that merely includes Puerto Williams.
Keep commercial operators distinct from FACH, DGAC, DIRECTEMAR and INACH roles.
Use the shared King George projection for stable destination-side context instead of duplicating its claims here.
Any current schedules, prices, availability, weather, NOTAM or port condition require live first-party or official verification.
